versions.content: If BusNmType is NM_BUSNM_LOCALNM and ComM requests Nm_- PassiveStartUp() or Nm_NetworkRequest() then Nm shall inform ComM about start of network by calling ComM_Nm_NetworkMode() . Rationale : Buses of type NM_LOCAL_NM which are coordinated do not have a network management message but are synchronized e.g. by a master - slave concept like LIN). These Bus-Types are always directly started on request by ComM but the shutdown will be done by coordinator algorithm.
